gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve the list of dynamic modules registered in the Jira Cloud platform so that I can verify their current status and configuration.
gold.ideal: The response should return a JSON array of dynamic modules, including their IDs, types, and current states.

gold.user: As an app administrator, I want to register new dynamic modules with the Jira Cloud platform so that they can be utilized within the application.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the successful registration of the modules with their IDs and any relevant metadata.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to remove specific dynamic modules from the Jira Cloud platform to clean up unused resources and improve performance.
gold.ideal: The response should indicate the successful deletion of the specified dynamic modules and confirm that they are no longer available.
